questions.question: Six students, Abhay, Bhanu, Charu, David, Ekta and Farheen, are the top six rank holders in a school. The rank of Bhanu is between the ranks of Charu and David. Bhanu is on the fourth rank. There are two students between the ranks of Ekta and David. Ekta is at the lowest rank among all the given students. The rank of Abhay is immediately below the rank of Farheen. Who is on the fifth rank?
questions.solution:
Six students, **Abhay, Bhanu, Charu, David, Ekta and Farheen**, are the top six rank holders in a school. 

1. Bhanu is on the fourth rank. 

_____ > _____ > _____ > Bhanu > _____ > _____

2. Ekta is at the lowest rank among all the given students. 

_____ > _____ > _____ > Bhanu > _____ > Ekta

3. There are two students between the ranks of Ekta and David. 

_____ > _____ > David > Bhanu > _____ > Ekta

4. The rank of Bhanu is between the ranks of Charu and David.

_____ > _____ > David > Bhanu > Charu > Ekta

5. The rank of Abhay is immediately below the rank of Farheen. 

Farheen > Abhay > David > Bhanu > Charu > Ekta

Clearly, Charu is on the fifth rank.

Hence, '**Charu**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some locks are keys.

No key is a chain.

All springs are chains.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some keys are springs.

II. No key is a spring.

III. No lock is a spring.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Either conclusion I or II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b9f173629c73b6b7d5d3f2ac7c344c00227a893f3ed9ebaecb0f75d6241baad.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some keys are springs. → Does not follow (As, No key is a chain and All springs are chains → No key is spring)

II. No key is a spring. → **Follow **(As, No key is a chain and All springs are chains → No key is spring)

III. No lock is a spring. → Does not follow (it is possible but not definite)

Hence, **Only conclusion II follows**.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L G _ Q _ G P _ L _ P Q _ G _ Q

options.text: P, L, P, G, L, Q
P, L, Q, G, L, P
P, Q, L, G, P, L
P, P, L, G, Q, L

questions.solution:
Given sequence: L G _ Q _ G P _ L _ P Q _ G _ Q

 
• P, L, P, G, L, Q → L G **P** Q - **L** G P **P -** L **G** P Q - **L** G **Q** Q
 
• P, L, Q, G, L, P → L G **P** Q - **L** G P **Q** - L **G** P Q - **L** G **P** Q
 
• P, Q, L, G, P, L → L G **P** Q - **Q** G P **L -** L **G** P Q - **P** G **L** Q
 
• P, P, L, G, Q, L → L G **P** Q - **P** G P **L -** L **G** P Q - **Q** G **L** Q

 
• In option 2, LGPQ is repeated.

Hence, '**P, L, Q, G, L, P**' is the correct answer.
